item.title: BPL Power Crisis, Electoral Reform, Passport Fraud
item.ns0:title: BPL Power Crisis, Electoral Reform, Passport Fraud
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, Prime Minister Philip Davis addresses the nation on the deepening power crisis and the staggering overtime payouts sparking controversy at BPL. Industrial tensions reach a boiling point as electrical unions initiate "work to rule" action following the suspension of members, while officials weigh major new recommendations for sweeping electoral reform. We also dive into a high-stakes fraud case involving a falsified passport and bring you the latest developments on a sensitive sexual assault investigation. Stay tuned for these stories and a look at Bahamian athletes making waves on the international stage.
